known_limitations: Test was authored via static review only; per policy no Unity executable was run, so pass/fail status, exit code, and XML results are not available and are not claimed.

The test constructs a minimal in-memory GameObject hierarchy (background Image parent + child fill Image) rather than opening the committed DoorPrototype scene, so it proves PlayerManaUI's ResolveFlashTargetImage/flash behavior in isolation; it does not by itself confirm the committed scene's actual Canvas hierarchy wires a background/frame Image as the fill Image's parent. A human should visually confirm in Play Mode that the scene-authored mana bar frame flashes as expected at zero mana.

Existing UI tests (which use a fill Image with no parent) were left unchanged since they already correctly exercise the fallback-to-self path in ResolveFlashTargetImage; no existing test needed modification.
structured_output.proposed_unity_test_scope: Play Mode test run scoped to NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests.PlayerManaPlayModeTests (Unity Test Runner, Play Mode), e.g. `-runTests -testPlatform PlayMode -assemblyNames NoSafeCircle.DoorPrototype.Tests -testFilter PlayerManaPlayModeTests` against a clean working tree, followed by tree/HEAD verification per the Unity Testing Policy post-run checklist.
structured_output.summary: Added one new Play Mode regression test to PlayerManaPlayModeTests.cs covering the human-review rejection: denied-cast feedback must remain visible when CurrentMana == 0. The new test builds a background/frame Image + child fill Image hierarchy (mirroring the production ResolveFlashTargetImage parent-lookup), drains mana to exactly zero, triggers a denied spend, and asserts the parent background Image flashes the denied color and reverts to its actual scene-authored color afterward, independent of fillAmount (which is asserted to be 0). No production code or other test paths were touched; the asmdef required no changes since UnityEngine.UI was already referenced.
test_cases_added_or_updated: PlayerManaUI_FlashesParentBackgroundImage_OnCastDenied_WhenCurrentManaIsZero (new, VAL-002/VAL-003 regression coverage for the prior human-review rejection)
